 587    def set_terminal_font(self, font: QFont):
 588        # Family and size set explicitly: a size left unset would be measured
 589        # at the application's default size but drawn at the widget's.
 590        size = font.pointSizeF() if font.pointSizeF() > 0 else QApplication.font().pointSizeF()
 591        font = QFont(font)
 592        font.setFamily(font.family())
 593        font.setPointSizeF(size)
 594        font.setStyleHint(QFont.Monospace)
 595        font.setFixedPitch(True)
 596        font.setKerning(False)
 597        self.font_normal = font
 598        self.font_bold = QFont(font)
 599        self.font_bold.setBold(True)
 600        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, self)  # (as drawn on this widget: its screen's resolution)
 601        self.cell_width = metrics.horizontalAdvance("M")
 602        self.cell_height = metrics.lineSpacing()
 603        self.ascent = metrics.ascent()
 604        self._fit()
 605        self.update()
 606
 607    def connect_scroll_bar(self, bar: QScrollBar):
 608        self.scroll_bar = bar
 609        bar.valueChanged.connect(self._scrolled)
 610        self._update_scroll_bar()
 611
 612    def connect_hscroll_bar(self, bar: QScrollBar):
 613        self.hscroll_bar = bar
 614        bar.valueChanged.connect(self._hscrolled)
 615        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 616
 617    def set_word_wrap(self, on: bool):
 618        """With word wrap the terminal is as wide as the window and long
 619        lines wrap; without, it's NO_WRAP_COLUMNS wide and the window shows
 620        part of it (the shell is told the real width either way, so line
 621        editing and full-screen programs stay right)."""
 622        self.word_wrap = on
 623        if on:
 624            self._hscroll = 0
 625        self._fit()
 626        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 627        self.update()
 628
 629    # ----------------------------------------------------------- output
 630    def feed(self, data: bytes):
 631        """Output from the shell."""
 632        before = len(self.screen.history)
 633        self.stream.feed(data)
 634        added = len(self.screen.history) - before
 635        if added:  # (lines scrolled into the scrollback: everything in view moved)
 636            self._redraw_all = True
 637        if self._scroll:  # (reading the scrollback: keep the same lines in view)
 638            self._scroll = min(self._scroll + max(0, added), len(self.screen.history))
 639        if not self._repaint_timer.isActive():
 640            self._repaint_timer.start()
 641
 642    def _after_output(self):
 643        hscroll = self._hscroll
 644        self._update_scroll_bar()
 645        self.ensure_cursor_visible()
 646        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 647        if self._redraw_all or self._scroll or self._scroll_px or self._hscroll != hscroll:
 648            self.update()  # (scrolled: every row in view is another)
 649        else:
 650            self._update_rows(set(self.screen.dirty))
 651        self._redraw_all = False
 652        self.screen.dirty.clear()
 653
 654    def _update_rows(self, rows: set[int]):
 655        """Repaint only these screen rows (what the output changed), and the
 656        cursor's old and new rows."""
 657        cursor = self.screen.cursor.y
 658        rows |= {cursor, self._cursor_drawn_at}
 659        for row in rows:
 660            if 0 <= row < self.screen.lines:
 661                top = int(PADDING + row * self.cell_height)
 662                self.update(0, top, self.width(), int(self.cell_height) + 2)
 663
 664    # ------------------------------------------------- sideways (no wrap)
 665    def _used_columns(self) -> int:
 666        """How far the text in view (and the cursor) reaches, in columns."""
 667        screen = self.screen
 668        first = len(screen.history) - self._scroll
 669        cursor_row = len(screen.history) + screen.cursor.y - first
 670        widest = screen.cursor.x + 1 if 0 <= cursor_row < screen.lines else 0
 671        blank = screen.default_char
 672        for n in range(first, first + screen.lines):
 673            line = self.line(n)
 674            if isinstance(line, list):
 675                end = len(line)
 676                while end > widest and line[end - 1] == blank:
 677                    end -= 1
 678            else:  # (a screen line: only the cells written are in it)
 679                end = max((x + 1 for x, cell in line.items() if cell != blank), default=0)
 680            widest = max(widest, min(end, screen.columns))
 681        return widest
 682
 683    def _scroll_range(self) -> int:
 684        """How far the view can scroll sideways (pixels): to the end of the
 685        widest text in view, not the terminal's full width."""
 686        if self.word_wrap:
 687            return 0
 688        return max(0, int(self._used_columns() * self.cell_width + 2 * PADDING) - self.width())
 689
 690    def _update_hscroll_bar(self):
 691        bar = self.hscroll_bar
 692        maximum = self._scroll_range()
 693        self._hscroll = min(self._hscroll, maximum)
 694        if bar is None:
 695            return
 696        bar.blockSignals(True)
 697        bar.setRange(0, maximum)
 698        bar.setPageStep(max(1, self.width()))
 699        bar.setSingleStep(max(1, int(self.cell_width * 4)))
 700        bar.setValue(self._hscroll)
 701        bar.blockSignals(False)
 702        # Shown only when there's something to scroll to; without word wrap
 703        # its room is kept while hidden, so the terminal's height (and the
 704        # shell's idea of it) doesn't change as it comes and goes.
 705        policy = bar.sizePolicy()
 706        if policy.retainSizeWhenHidden() == self.word_wrap:
 707            policy.setRetainSizeWhenHidden(not self.word_wrap)
 708            bar.setSizePolicy(policy)
 709            layout = bar.parentWidget().layout() if bar.parentWidget() else None
 710            if layout is not None:  # (a hidden widget's new policy doesn't re-lay-out by itself)
 711                layout.invalidate()
 712                layout.activate()
 713        bar.setVisible(maximum > 0)
 714
 715    def _hscrolled(self, value: int):
 716        self._hscroll = value
 717        self.update()
 718
 719    def scroll_sideways(self, pixels: int):
 720        if not self.word_wrap:
 721            self._hscroll = max(0, min(self._scroll_range(), self._hscroll + pixels))
 722            self._update_hscroll_bar()
 723            self.update()
 724
 725    def ensure_cursor_visible(self):
 726        """Without word wrap: scroll sideways to the cursor (as you type, and
 727        back to the left at a new prompt)."""
 728        if self.word_wrap or self._scroll or self._scroll_px:
 729            return
 730        x = PADDING + self.screen.cursor.x * self.cell_width
 731        margin = 4 * self.cell_width
 732        if x < self._hscroll + margin:
 733            self._hscroll = int(max(0, x - margin)) if x > self.width() - margin else 0
 734        elif x + self.cell_width > self._hscroll + self.width() - margin:
 735            self._hscroll = int(x + self.cell_width + margin - self.width())
 736        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 737
 738    def _update_scroll_bar(self):
 739        bar = self.scroll_bar
 740        if bar is None:
 741            return
 742        history = len(self.screen.history)
 743        bar.blockSignals(True)
 744        bar.setRange(0, history)
 745        bar.setPageStep(self.screen.lines)
 746        bar.setValue(history - self._scroll)
 747        bar.blockSignals(False)
 748
 749    def _scrolled(self, value: int):
 750        self._scroll = max(0, len(self.screen.history) - value)
 751        self._scroll_px = 0.0
 752        self._update_hscroll_bar()  # (the lines now in view may be wider or narrower)
 753        self.update()
 754
 755    def scroll_pixels(self, pixels: float):
 756        """Scroll the view up (positive) or down by pixels, through the
 757        scrollback: smoothly, part of a line at a time (a trackpad)."""
 758        history, ch = len(self.screen.history), self.cell_height
 759        total = max(0.0, min(history * ch, self._scroll * ch + self._scroll_px + pixels))
 760        self._scroll = min(history, int(total // ch))
 761        self._scroll_px = total - self._scroll * ch if self._scroll < history else 0.0
 762        self._update_scroll_bar()
 763        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 764        self.update()
 765
 766    def scroll_lines(self, lines: int):
 767        """Scroll the view up (positive) or down through the scrollback."""
 768        self._scroll = max(0, min(len(self.screen.history), self._scroll + lines))
 769        self._scroll_px = 0.0
 770        self._update_scroll_bar()
 771        self._update_hscroll_bar()
 772        self.update()
 773
 774    # ------------------------------------------------------------ text
 775    def total_lines(self) -> int:
 776        return len(self.screen.history) + self.screen.lines
 777
 778    def line(self, n: int):
 779        """Line ``n`` of the scrollback and screen (a list or pyte line of Chars)."""
 780        history = self.screen.history
 781        return history[n] if n < len(history) else self.screen.buffer[n - len(history)]
 782
 783    def _line_text(self, n: int, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None) -> str:
 784        line = self.line(n)
 785        width = len(line) if isinstance(line, list) else self.screen.columns
 786        end = width if end is None else min(end, width)
 787        return "".join(line[x].data for x in range(start, end)).rstrip()
 788
 789    def text(self) -> str:
 790        """All the text: the scrollback, then the screen."""
 791        lines = [self._line_text(n) for n in range(self.total_lines())]
 792        while lines and not lines[-1]:
 793            lines.pop()
 794        return "\n".join(lines)
 795
 796    def selected_text(self) -> str:
 797        if not self._selection:
 798            return ""
 799        (l1, c1), (l2, c2) = sorted(self._selection)
 800        if l1 == l2:
 801            return self._line_text(l1, c1, c2 + 1)
 802        parts = [self._line_text(l1, c1)] + [self._line_text(n) for n in range(l1 + 1, l2)]
 803        return "\n".join(parts + [self._line_text(l2, 0, c2 + 1)])
 804
 805    def _row_selection(self, n: int, width: int) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
 806        """The columns of line ``n`` that are selected, [start, end), or None."""
 807        if not self._selection:
 808            return None
 809        (l1, c1), (l2, c2) = sorted(self._selection)
 810        if not l1 <= n <= l2:
 811            return None
 812        return (c1 if n == l1 else 0), (c2 + 1 if n == l2 else width)
 813
 814    # ---------------------------------------------------- Edit menu, clipboard
 815    def copy(self):
 816        text = self.selected_text()
 817        if text:
 818            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
 819
 820    def paste(self):
 821        text = QApplication.clipboard().text()
 822        if not text:
 823            return
 824        data = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\n", "\r").encode("utf-8")
 825        if BRACKETED_PASTE in self.screen.mode:  # (so the shell doesn't run it line by line)
 826            data = b"\x1b[200~" + data + b"\x1b[201~"
 827        self._input(data)
 828
 829    def cut(self):
 830        self.copy()
 831
 832    def selectAll(self):
 833        last = self.total_lines() - 1
 834        self._selection = ((0, 0), (last, self.screen.columns - 1))
 835        self.update()
 836
 837    # (These exist so the Edit menu doesn't reach past the terminal to the editor.)
 838    def undo(self):
 839        pass
 840
 841    def redo(self):
 842        pass
 843
 844    def clear_scrollback(self):
 845        """⌘K: forget the scrollback and redraw the prompt at the top."""
 846        self.screen.history.clear()
 847        self._scroll, self._scroll_px = 0, 0.0
 848        self._selection = None
 849        self._update_scroll_bar()
 850        self._input(b"\x0c")  # Ctrl+L
 851
 852    # ------------------------------------------------------------ keys
 853    def _input(self, data: bytes):
 854        """Typing goes to the shell, and back to the bottom of the output."""
 855        if self._scroll or self._scroll_px or self._selection:
 856            self._scroll, self._scroll_px, self._selection = 0, 0.0, None
 857            self._update_scroll_bar()
 858            self.update()
 859        self.write(data)
 860
 861    def focusNextPrevChild(self, _next):
 862        return False  # Tab goes to the shell (completion), not to the next widget
 863
 864    def _wanted(self, event) -> bool:
 865        """Keys the terminal takes before the window's shortcuts: Control
 866        combinations (Ctrl+C must interrupt, not copy), Escape and Tab."""
 867        mods = event.modifiers() & ~Qt.KeypadModifier
 868        if mods & CONTROL and not mods & Qt.ShiftModifier and not (MAC and mods & COMMAND):
 869            return True
 870        return mods == Qt.NoModifier and event.key() in (Qt.Key_Escape, Qt.Key_Tab)
 871
 872    def event(self, event):
 873        if event.type() == QEvent.ShortcutOverride and self._wanted(event):
 874            event.accept()
 875            return True
 876        return super().event(event)
 877
 878    def key_bytes(self, key: int, mods, text: str) -> bytes | None:
 879        """What xterm sends for a key (None: nothing)."""
 880        shift, alt, ctrl = bool(mods & Qt.ShiftModifier), bool(mods & Qt.AltModifier), bool(mods & CONTROL)
 881        modifier = 1 + shift + 2 * alt + 4 * ctrl  # (xterm's modifier parameter)
 882        if MAC and alt and not ctrl and key in (Qt.Key_Left, Qt.Key_Right):
 883            return b"\x1bb" if key == Qt.Key_Left else b"\x1bf"  # Option+arrow: a word
 884        if key in CURSOR_KEYS:
 885            final = CURSOR_KEYS[key]
 886            if modifier > 1:
 887                return f"\x1b[1;{modifier}{final}".encode()
 888            return f"\x1b{'O' if DECCKM in self.screen.mode else '['}{final}".encode()
 889        if key in TILDE_KEYS:
 890            number = TILDE_KEYS[key]
 891            return (f"\x1b[{number};{modifier}~" if modifier > 1 else f"\x1b[{number}~").encode()
 892        if key in SS3_KEYS:
 893            return (f"\x1b[1;{modifier}{SS3_KEYS[key]}" if modifier > 1 else f"\x1bO{SS3_KEYS[key]}").encode()
 894        if key == Qt.Key_Backtab:
 895            return b"\x1b[Z"
 896        if key in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter):
 897            return b"\r"
 898        if key == Qt.Key_Backspace:
 899            return b"\x08" if ctrl else b"\x7f"
 900        if key == Qt.Key_Escape:
 901            return b"\x1b"
 902        if key == Qt.Key_Tab:
 903            return b"\t"
 904        if ctrl:
 905            if Qt.Key_A <= key <= Qt.Key_Z:
 906                return bytes([key - Qt.Key_A + 1])
 907            control = {Qt.Key_Space: 0, Qt.Key_At: 0, Qt.Key_BracketLeft: 27, Qt.Key_Backslash: 28,
 908                       Qt.Key_BracketRight: 29, Qt.Key_AsciiCircum: 30, Qt.Key_Underscore: 31,
 909                       Qt.Key_Minus: 31, Qt.Key_Slash: 31}
 910            if key in control:
 911                return bytes([control[key]])
 912        if text:
 913            data = text.encode("utf-8")
 914            # Alt+key: ESC first (on macOS Option types characters instead).
 915            return b"\x1b" + data if alt and not MAC else data
 916        return None
 917
 918    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
 919        key, mods, text = event.key(), event.modifiers() & ~Qt.KeypadModifier, event.text()
 920        if MAC and mods & COMMAND:  # ⌘: the app's, not the shell's
 921            actions = {Qt.Key_C: self.copy, Qt.Key_V: self.paste, Qt.Key_K: self.clear_scrollback,
 922                       Qt.Key_A: self.selectAll}
 923            if key in actions:
 924                actions[key]()
 925            else:
 926                event.ignore()
 927            return
 928        if not MAC and mods == (Qt.ControlModifier | Qt.ShiftModifier) and key in (Qt.Key_C, Qt.Key_V):
 929            self.copy() if key == Qt.Key_C else self.paste()
 930            return
 931        if mods == Qt.ShiftModifier and key in (Qt.Key_PageUp, Qt.Key_PageDown):  # read the scrollback
 932            self.scroll_lines(self.screen.lines - 1 if key == Qt.Key_PageUp else 1 - self.screen.lines)
 933            return
 934        data = self.key_bytes(key, mods, text)
 935        if data:
 936            self._input(data)
 937        else:
 938            event.ignore()
 939
 940    # ------------------------------------------------------------ mouse
 941    def _cell_at(self, pos) -> tuple[int, int]:
 942        """(line in scrollback + screen, column) under a point."""
 943        row = int((pos.y() - PADDING - self._scroll_px) // self.cell_height)
 944        col = int((pos.x() + self._hscroll - PADDING) // self.cell_width)
 945        row = max(-1 if self._scroll_px else 0, min(self.screen.lines - 1, row))
 946        col = max(0, min(self.screen.columns - 1, col))
 947        return len(self.screen.history) - self._scroll + row, col
 948
 949    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
 950        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
 951            cell = self._cell_at(event.position())
 952            self._selection = (cell, cell)
 953            self._selecting = True
 954            self.update()
 955        super().mousePressEvent(event)
 956
 957    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
 958        if getattr(self, "_selecting", False) and self._selection:
 959            self._selection = (self._selection[0], self._cell_at(event.position()))
 960            self.update()
 961
 962    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
 963        self._selecting = False
 964        if self._selection and self._selection[0] == self._selection[1]:
 965            self._selection = None  # (a click, not a selection)
 966            self.update()
 967        elif self._selection and not MAC and sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
 968            QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.selected_text(), QClipboard.Selection)
 969
 970    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self, event):
 971        """Select the word under the mouse."""
 972        n, x = self._cell_at(event.position())
 973        text = self._line_text(n).ljust(self.screen.columns)
 974
 975        def in_word(c):
 976            return c.isalnum() or c in "_-./~:@%+"
 977
 978        if x < len(text) and in_word(text[x]):
 979            start, end = x, x
 980            while start > 0 and in_word(text[start - 1]):
 981                start -= 1
 982            while end + 1 < len(text) and in_word(text[end + 1]):
 983                end += 1
 984            self._selection = ((n, start), (n, end))
 985            self.update()
 986
 987    def wheelEvent(self, event):
 988        """Scroll through the scrollback (or, in a full-screen program, send it
 989        arrow keys, as xterm does). A trackpad's distance is in pixels and
 990        comes in many small steps: they add up, the part of a line left over
 991        kept for the next one, so a swipe up and back down the same distance
 992        ends where it started."""
 993        pixels, angle = event.pixelDelta(), event.angleDelta()
 994        dx, dy = pixels.x() or angle.x(), pixels.y() or angle.y()
 995        if event.modifiers() & Qt.ShiftModifier:
 996            dx, dy = dx or dy, 0  # (Shift+wheel: sideways)
 997        if abs(dx) > abs(dy):  # (mostly sideways: a vertical swipe's bit of sideways doesn't count)
 998            self.scroll_sideways(-dx)
 999            return
1000        # Up and down: a trackpad in its exact pixels; a mouse wheel 3 lines a notch.
1001        distance = pixels.y() if pixels.y() else angle.y() / 120 * 3 * self.cell_height
1002        if not distance:
1003            return
1004        if not self.screen.alternate:
1005            self.scroll_pixels(distance)
1006            return
1007        # Full-screen programs: the wheel is arrow keys (as in xterm), a line at a time.
1008        self._wheel_rest += distance / max(1.0, self.cell_height)
1009        whole = int(self._wheel_rest)  # (towards zero: the rest waits for the next step)
1010        self._wheel_rest -= whole
1011        if whole:
1012            key = Qt.Key_Up if whole > 0 else Qt.Key_Down
1013            self.write(self.key_bytes(key, Qt.NoModifier, "") * abs(whole))
1014
1015    def contextMenuEvent(self, event):
1016        from qtpy.QtWidgets import QMenu
1017
1018        menu = QMenu(self)
1019        copy = menu.addAction("Copy", self.copy)
1020        copy.setEnabled(bool(self._selection))
1021        menu.addAction("Paste", self.paste)
1022        menu.addAction("Select All", self.selectAll)
1023        menu.addSeparator()
1024        menu.addAction("Clear Scrollback", self.clear_scrollback)
1025        menu.exec(event.globalPos())
1026
1027    # -------------------------------------------------------- drawing
1028    def _fit(self):
1029        """Columns and rows for the widget's size, or wider without word
1030        wrap (the shell is told)."""
1031        cols = max(2, int((self.width() - 2 * PADDING) // self.cell_width))
1032        if not self.word_wrap:
1033            cols = max(cols, NO_WRAP_COLUMNS)
1034        rows = max(1, int((self.height() - 2 * PADDING) // self.cell_height))
1035        if (rows, cols) != (self.screen.lines, self.screen.columns):
1036            self.screen.resize(rows, cols)
1037            self._scroll, self._scroll_px = min(self._scroll, len(self.screen.history)), 0.0
1038            self._update_scroll_bar()
1039            self.size_changed.emit(rows, cols)
1040
1041    def resizeEvent(self, event):
1042        super().resizeEvent(event)
1043        self._fit()
1044        self._update_hscroll_bar()
1045
1046    def focusInEvent(self, event):
1047        super().focusInEvent(event)
1048        self.update()
1049
1050    def focusOutEvent(self, event):
1051        super().focusOutEvent(event)
1052        self.update()
1053
1054    def _color(self, name: str, default: QColor) -> QColor:
1055        if name == "default":
1056            return default
1057        color = self._colors.get(name)
1058        if color is None:
1059            if name in ANSI_NAMES:
1060                color = self.ansi[ANSI_NAMES[name]]
1061            elif name in ANSI_HEX:
1062                color = self.ansi[ANSI_HEX[name]]
1063            else:
1064                color = QColor("#" + name) if len(name) == 6 else QColor(default)
1065            self._colors[name] = color
1066        return color
1067
1068    def paintEvent(self, event):
1069        painter = QPainter(self)
1070        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), self.background)
1071        offset = self._scroll_px  # (scrolled part of a line further: everything a bit lower)
1072        painter.translate(-self._hscroll, offset)  # (and sideways, without word wrap)
1073        screen = self.screen
1074        history = len(screen.history)
1075        first = history - self._scroll
1076        ch = self.cell_height
1077        palette = self.palette()
1078        select_bg = palette.color(QPalette.Highlight)
1079        select_fg = palette.color(QPalette.HighlightedText)
1080        top_row = max(-1 if offset else 0, int((event.rect().top() - PADDING - offset) // ch))
1081        bottom_row = min(screen.lines - 1, int((event.rect().bottom() - PADDING - offset) // ch))
1082        for row in range(top_row, bottom_row + 1):
1083            n = first + row
1084            if n < 0:
1085                continue
1086            line = self.line(n)
1087            width = min(len(line), screen.columns) if isinstance(line, list) else screen.columns
1088            span = self._row_selection(n, width)  # (once per row: not per cell)
1089            y = PADDING + row * ch
1090            x = 0
1091            while x < width:
1092                cell = line[x]
1093                selected = span is not None and span[0] <= x < span[1]
1094                style = (cell.fg, cell.bg, cell.bold, cell.italics, cell.underscore,
1095                         cell.strikethrough, cell.reverse, selected)
1096                start, chars = x, [cell.data]
1097                x += 1
1098                while x < width:  # (a run of cells drawn alike)
1099                    other = line[x]
1100                    if (other.fg, other.bg, other.bold, other.italics, other.underscore, other.strikethrough,
1101                            other.reverse, span is not None and span[0] <= x < span[1]) != style:
1102                        break
1103                    chars.append(other.data)
1104                    x += 1
1105                self._draw_run(painter, start, y, chars, cell, selected, select_bg, select_fg)
1106        self._draw_cursor(painter, first)
1107
1108    def _draw_run(self, painter, column, y, chars, cell, selected, select_bg, select_fg):
1109        cw, ch = self.cell_width, self.cell_height
1110        fg = self._color(cell.fg, self.foreground)
1111        bg = self._color(cell.bg, self.background)
1112        if cell.reverse:
1113            fg, bg = bg, fg
1114        if selected:
1115            fg, bg = select_fg, select_bg
1116        x0 = PADDING + column * cw
1117        if bg != self.background:
1118            painter.fillRect(QRectF(x0, y, len(chars) * cw, ch), bg)
1119        text = "".join(chars)
1120        if not text.strip():
1121            return
1122        font = self.font_bold if cell.bold else self.font_normal
1123        if cell.italics or cell.underscore or cell.strikethrough:
1124            font = QFont(font)
1125            font.setItalic(cell.italics)
1126            font.setUnderline(cell.underscore)
1127            font.setStrikeOut(cell.strikethrough)
1128        painter.setFont(font)
1129        painter.setPen(fg)
1130        baseline = y + self.ascent
1131        if text.isascii():
1132            painter.drawText(QPointF(x0, baseline), text)
1133        else:  # (each character in its cell: wide ones take two, the next is empty)
1134            for i, c in enumerate(chars):
1135                if c:
1136                    painter.drawText(QPointF(x0 + i * cw, baseline), c)
1137
1138    def _draw_cursor(self, painter, first):
1139        screen = self.screen
1140        self._cursor_drawn_at = screen.cursor.y
1141        row = len(screen.history) + screen.cursor.y - first
1142        if screen.cursor.hidden or not 0 <= row < screen.lines:
1143            return
1144        x = PADDING + screen.cursor.x * self.cell_width
1145        y = PADDING + row * self.cell_height
1146        rect = QRectF(x, y, self.cell_width, self.cell_height)
1147        if self.hasFocus():
1148            painter.fillRect(rect, self.foreground)
1149            cell = screen.buffer[screen.cursor.y][screen.cursor.x]
1150            if cell.data.strip():
1151                painter.setFont(self.font_bold if cell.bold else self.font_normal)
1152                painter.setPen(self.background)
1153                painter.drawText(QPointF(x, y + self.ascent), cell.data)
1154        else:
1155            painter.setPen(self.foreground)
1156            painter.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
1157            painter.drawRect(rect.adjusted(0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5))

def feed(self, data: bytes): 
630    def feed(self, data: bytes):
631        """Output from the shell."""
632        before = len(self.screen.history)
633        self.stream.feed(data)
634        added = len(self.screen.history) - before
635        if added:  # (lines scrolled into the scrollback: everything in view moved)
636            self._redraw_all = True
637        if self._scroll:  # (reading the scrollback: keep the same lines in view)
638            self._scroll = min(self._scroll + max(0, added), len(self.screen.history))
639        if not self._repaint_timer.isActive():
640            self._repaint_timer.start()

def ensure_cursor_visible(self): 
725    def ensure_cursor_visible(self):
726        """Without word wrap: scroll sideways to the cursor (as you type, and
727        back to the left at a new prompt)."""
728        if self.word_wrap or self._scroll or self._scroll_px:
729            return
730        x = PADDING + self.screen.cursor.x * self.cell_width
731        margin = 4 * self.cell_width
732        if x < self._hscroll + margin:
733            self._hscroll = int(max(0, x - margin)) if x > self.width() - margin else 0
734        elif x + self.cell_width > self._hscroll + self.width() - margin:
735            self._hscroll = int(x + self.cell_width + margin - self.width())
736        self._update_hscroll_bar()

def scroll_pixels(self, pixels: float): 
755    def scroll_pixels(self, pixels: float):
756        """Scroll the view up (positive) or down by pixels, through the
757        scrollback: smoothly, part of a line at a time (a trackpad)."""
758        history, ch = len(self.screen.history), self.cell_height
759        total = max(0.0, min(history * ch, self._scroll * ch + self._scroll_px + pixels))
760        self._scroll = min(history, int(total // ch))
761        self._scroll_px = total - self._scroll * ch if self._scroll < history else 0.0
762        self._update_scroll_bar()
763        self._update_hscroll_bar()
764        self.update()

def key_bytes(self, key: int, mods, text: str) -> bytes | None: 
878    def key_bytes(self, key: int, mods, text: str) -> bytes | None:
879        """What xterm sends for a key (None: nothing)."""
880        shift, alt, ctrl = bool(mods & Qt.ShiftModifier), bool(mods & Qt.AltModifier), bool(mods & CONTROL)
881        modifier = 1 + shift + 2 * alt + 4 * ctrl  # (xterm's modifier parameter)
882        if MAC and alt and not ctrl and key in (Qt.Key_Left, Qt.Key_Right):
883            return b"\x1bb" if key == Qt.Key_Left else b"\x1bf"  # Option+arrow: a word
884        if key in CURSOR_KEYS:
885            final = CURSOR_KEYS[key]
886            if modifier > 1:
887                return f"\x1b[1;{modifier}{final}".encode()
888            return f"\x1b{'O' if DECCKM in self.screen.mode else '['}{final}".encode()
889        if key in TILDE_KEYS:
890            number = TILDE_KEYS[key]
891            return (f"\x1b[{number};{modifier}~" if modifier > 1 else f"\x1b[{number}~").encode()
892        if key in SS3_KEYS:
893            return (f"\x1b[1;{modifier}{SS3_KEYS[key]}" if modifier > 1 else f"\x1bO{SS3_KEYS[key]}").encode()
894        if key == Qt.Key_Backtab:
895            return b"\x1b[Z"
896        if key in (Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Enter):
897            return b"\r"
898        if key == Qt.Key_Backspace:
899            return b"\x08" if ctrl else b"\x7f"
900        if key == Qt.Key_Escape:
901            return b"\x1b"
902        if key == Qt.Key_Tab:
903            return b"\t"
904        if ctrl:
905            if Qt.Key_A <= key <= Qt.Key_Z:
906                return bytes([key - Qt.Key_A + 1])
907            control = {Qt.Key_Space: 0, Qt.Key_At: 0, Qt.Key_BracketLeft: 27, Qt.Key_Backslash: 28,
908                       Qt.Key_BracketRight: 29, Qt.Key_AsciiCircum: 30, Qt.Key_Underscore: 31,
909                       Qt.Key_Minus: 31, Qt.Key_Slash: 31}
910            if key in control:
911                return bytes([control[key]])
912        if text:
913            data = text.encode("utf-8")
914            # Alt+key: ESC first (on macOS Option types characters instead).
915            return b"\x1b" + data if alt and not MAC else data
916        return None

What xterm sends for a key (None: nothing).

def keyPressEvent(self, event): 
918    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
919        key, mods, text = event.key(), event.modifiers() & ~Qt.KeypadModifier, event.text()
920        if MAC and mods & COMMAND:  # ⌘: the app's, not the shell's
921            actions = {Qt.Key_C: self.copy, Qt.Key_V: self.paste, Qt.Key_K: self.clear_scrollback,
922                       Qt.Key_A: self.selectAll}
923            if key in actions:
924                actions[key]()
925            else:
926                event.ignore()
927            return
928        if not MAC and mods == (Qt.ControlModifier | Qt.ShiftModifier) and key in (Qt.Key_C, Qt.Key_V):
929            self.copy() if key == Qt.Key_C else self.paste()
930            return
931        if mods == Qt.ShiftModifier and key in (Qt.Key_PageUp, Qt.Key_PageDown):  # read the scrollback
932            self.scroll_lines(self.screen.lines - 1 if key == Qt.Key_PageUp else 1 - self.screen.lines)
933            return
934        data = self.key_bytes(key, mods, text)
935        if data:
936            self._input(data)
937        else:
938            event.ignore()

971        """Select the word under the mouse."""

974
975        def in_word(c):
976            return c.isalnum() or c in "_-./~:@%+"
977
978        if x < len(text) and in_word(text[x]):
979            start, end = x, x
980            while start > 0 and in_word(text[start - 1]):

def wheelEvent(self, event): 
 987    def wheelEvent(self, event):
 988        """Scroll through the scrollback (or, in a full-screen program, send it
 989        arrow keys, as xterm does). A trackpad's distance is in pixels and
 990        comes in many small steps: they add up, the part of a line left over
 991        kept for the next one, so a swipe up and back down the same distance
 992        ends where it started."""
 993        pixels, angle = event.pixelDelta(), event.angleDelta()
 994        dx, dy = pixels.x() or angle.x(), pixels.y() or angle.y()
 995        if event.modifiers() & Qt.ShiftModifier:
 996            dx, dy = dx or dy, 0  # (Shift+wheel: sideways)
 997        if abs(dx) > abs(dy):  # (mostly sideways: a vertical swipe's bit of sideways doesn't count)
 998            self.scroll_sideways(-dx)
 999            return
1000        # Up and down: a trackpad in its exact pixels; a mouse wheel 3 lines a notch.
1001        distance = pixels.y() if pixels.y() else angle.y() / 120 * 3 * self.cell_height
1002        if not distance:
1003            return
1004        if not self.screen.alternate:
1005            self.scroll_pixels(distance)
1006            return
1007        # Full-screen programs: the wheel is arrow keys (as in xterm), a line at a time.
1008        self._wheel_rest += distance / max(1.0, self.cell_height)
1009        whole = int(self._wheel_rest)  # (towards zero: the rest waits for the next step)
1010        self._wheel_rest -= whole
1011        if whole:
1012            key = Qt.Key_Up if whole > 0 else Qt.Key_Down
1013            self.write(self.key_bytes(key, Qt.NoModifier, "") * abs(whole))

Scroll through the scrollback (or, in a full-screen program, send it arrow keys, as xterm does). A trackpad's distance is in pixels and comes in many small steps: they add up, the part of a line left over kept for the next one, so a swipe up and back down the same distance ends where it started.

def paintEvent(self, event): 
1068    def paintEvent(self, event):
1069        painter = QPainter(self)
1070        painter.fillRect(self.rect(), self.background)
1071        offset = self._scroll_px  # (scrolled part of a line further: everything a bit lower)
1072        painter.translate(-self._hscroll, offset)  # (and sideways, without word wrap)
1073        screen = self.screen
1074        history = len(screen.history)
1075        first = history - self._scroll
1076        ch = self.cell_height
1077        palette = self.palette()
1078        select_bg = palette.color(QPalette.Highlight)
1079        select_fg = palette.color(QPalette.HighlightedText)
1080        top_row = max(-1 if offset else 0, int((event.rect().top() - PADDING - offset) // ch))
1081        bottom_row = min(screen.lines - 1, int((event.rect().bottom() - PADDING - offset) // ch))
1082        for row in range(top_row, bottom_row + 1):
1083            n = first + row
1084            if n < 0:
1085                continue
1086            line = self.line(n)
1087            width = min(len(line), screen.columns) if isinstance(line, list) else screen.columns
1088            span = self._row_selection(n, width)  # (once per row: not per cell)
1089            y = PADDING + row * ch
1090            x = 0
1091            while x < width:
1092                cell = line[x]
1093                selected = span is not None and span[0] <= x < span[1]
1094                style = (cell.fg, cell.bg, cell.bold, cell.italics, cell.underscore,
1095                         cell.strikethrough, cell.reverse, selected)
1096                start, chars = x, [cell.data]
1097                x += 1
1098                while x < width:  # (a run of cells drawn alike)
1099                    other = line[x]
1100                    if (other.fg, other.bg, other.bold, other.italics, other.underscore, other.strikethrough,
1101                            other.reverse, span is not None and span[0] <= x < span[1]) != style:
1102                        break
1103                    chars.append(other.data)
1104                    x += 1
1105                self._draw_run(painter, start, y, chars, cell, selected, select_bg, select_fg)
1106        self._draw_cursor(painter, first)

1198    def set_directory(self, directory: Path | None):
1199        """The project's folder: where the shell starts. A different one (another
1200        project opened) restarts a running shell there; the same one (the
1201        project reloaded) leaves it alone."""
1202        directory = directory if directory and directory.is_dir() else Path.home()
1203        moved = directory.resolve() != self.directory.resolve()
1204        self.directory = directory
1205        if moved and self.shell is not None and self.shell.is_running():
1206            self.restart(focus=False)
1207        elif self.shell is None:
1208            self._update_title()
1209
1210    def _update_title(self, note: str = ""):
1211        shell = Path(user_shell()).name
1212        folder = str(self.directory).replace(str(Path.home()), "~", 1)
1213        name = environment_name()
1214        env = f" · environment <b>{name}</b>" if name else ""
1215        self.title.setText(f"<b>{shell}</b> — {folder}{env}" + (f"  <i>({note})</i>" if note else ""))
1216        self.title.setToolTip("The shell has exactly the environment VibeFPMGUI was started with "
1217                              "(your shell's startup files aren't read, so nothing changes it).")
1218
1219    def start(self):
1220        """Start the shell (if it isn't running)."""
1221        if self.shell is not None and self.shell.is_running():
1222            return
1223        view = self.view
1224        kind = WinptyShell if WINDOWS else PtyShell
1225        launch = shell_launch()
1226        self.shell = kind(launch, self.directory, view.screen.lines, view.screen.columns, self)
1227        self.shell.output.connect(view.feed)
1228        self.shell.exited.connect(self._exited)
1229        view.write = self.shell.write
1230        try:
1231            self.shell.start()
1232        except (OSError, ImportError) as exc:
1233            view.feed(f"Could not start {launch.argv[0]}: {exc}\r\n".encode())
1234            self.shell = None
1235            return
1236        self._update_title()
1237
1238    def _resized(self, rows: int, cols: int):
1239        if self.shell is not None:
1240            self.shell.resize(rows, cols)
1241
1242    def _exited(self):
1243        self._update_title("exited — Restart for a new shell")
1244        self.view.feed(b"\r\n[The shell has exited.]\r\n")
1245
1246    def restart(self, focus: bool = True):
1247        """A new shell (in ``directory``), on a clean screen."""
1248        self.shutdown()
1249        self.view.feed(b"\x1bc")  # (reset: a clean screen)
1250        self.view.screen.history.clear()
1251        self.start()
1252        if focus:
1253            self.focus()
1254
1255    def focus(self):
1256        self.view.setFocus()
1257
1258    def type_command(self, command: str):
1259        """Type ``command`` at the shell's prompt and press Return (starting
1260        the shell first if needed)."""
1261        self.start()
1262        if self.shell is not None:
1263            self.shell.write((command + "\r").encode())
1264
1265    def showEvent(self, event):
1266        super().showEvent(event)
1267        QTimer.singleShot(0, self, self.start)  # (the first time the tab is shown: after it's laid out)
1268
1269    def refresh_colors(self):
1270        self.view.set_colors(*terminal_colors(QApplication.palette()))
1271
1272    def set_font(self, font: QFont):
1273        self.view.set_terminal_font(font)
1274
1275    def set_word_wrap(self, on: bool):
1276        """View → Word Wrap (see `TerminalView.set_word_wrap`)."""
1277        self.view.set_word_wrap(on)
1278
1279    def shutdown(self):
1280        if self.shell is not None:
1281            self.shell.exited.disconnect()
1282            self.shell.stop()
1283            self.shell = None
